race.comment: DARK ARTS (1) boasts the strongest form and is clearly the one to beat dropping back to tackle easier company. Suspect Thompson will be on top of his game from the inside pillar and be eager to hold a prominent spot. Looks very tough to beat. LITTLE FELLA (3) comes through a solid  BM78 at Doomben, where he was third to Propaganda after knuckling at the start and still working home. Second-up improvement and the 2kg claim keep him right in play. MERCATELLO (8) missed by a nose at Eagle Farm and is well suited back to 1200m, with a clear winning chance if she repeats that latest run. MEET GEORGE (7) returns from a 46-day freshen and is capable of making his presence felt if he gets back to his best. Keeping safe in the minors. Last start winner CRYPTIC BEAUTY (2) also deserves consideration for the minors.
